title: Outpatient Physical Therapy: Therapeutic Exercise

criteria.summary: Plan of care signed by the treating clinician
Standardized functional outcome measure recorded at evaluation

passages.text: This policy applies to outpatient professional claims for therapeutic exercise, CPT 97110, with dates of service on or after April 1, 2026.
Therapeutic exercise is considered medically necessary when criteria 3.1, 3.2, and 3.3 are met.
The evaluation documents a functional deficit, such as limited range of motion, reduced strength, or impaired gait, that affects daily activity.
A plan of care stating the treatment goals, frequency, and duration is signed by the treating clinician before therapy begins.
A standardized functional outcome measure is recorded at evaluation so that progress can be assessed objectively.

Documentation supporting each applicable criterion must be available in the medical record on request. Absence of documentation for a required criterion does not establish that the criterion was not met.
